name: autopilot
description: Drives your Claude Code sessions on its own: asks you pointed questions first when a prompt leaves the goal, constraints or check unclear, rewrites the prompts you type, decides permission asks and Claude's questions from the whole conversation, and after each turn sends the practical next step (fix, verify, commit, push, open the PR) until only you can decide what is left.

model.title: Rewrite model
model.description: The model that rewrites a session's first prompt and judges whether it needs questions, before there is a conversation to read: an alias (sonnet, haiku, opus) or a full model id. Later rewrites, permission asks, questions and the next step are decided by the session's own model over the whole conversation.

maxTurns.title: Turn cap
maxTurns.description: The most turns autopilot starts on its own for one goal before it stops and notifies you.

autoEngage.title: On in every session
autoEngage.description: On (default): every prompt you type becomes the goal and the session drives itself, deciding permission asks for you. Off: engage per session with /drive.
